recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If authoritative-source semantics or publisher-linking behavior need future work, start from the FHIR Extension Pack definitions and the publisher/tooling repository that consumes them, not by restoring the retired extension definition to FHIR core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary issue requesting a CodeSystem authoritativeSource uri extension for human-readable terminology source-of-truth URLs such as CDCREC, plus publisher use of that URL for browsing when populated.
initial_application: Core commit 9500b398d1 added source/codesystem/structuredefinition-extension-codesystem-authoritativeSource.xml with context CodeSystem, uri value type, and the requested source-of-truth definition; commit 86f05f16e6 attempted to list it in the CodeSystem implementation guide. The implementation used max 1 rather than the Jira resolution's max 0..*, matching the singular source-of-truth rationale in Jira and WGM minutes.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 removed CodeSystem and ValueSet authoritativeSource extension definitions from R5 core source as part of moving extensions out of core. Current core source has no active codesystem-authoritativeSource profile entry or CodeSystem extension-list entry, only the canonical OID registration. The Extension Pack now defines codesystem-authoritativeSource as retired/deprecated and later final issues FHIR-40730, FHIR-56275, and FHIR-56401 point users to the general artifact-authoritativeSource extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source was changed because reintroducing or editing a deprecated externally owned extension in core would conflict with the current repository split and later replacement guidance.

related_jiras.note: Applied FHIR-core decision that deprecated codesystem-authoritativeSource because it was poorly defined; already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit commit.
Published FHIR Extension Pack decision adding the general artifact-authoritativeSource replacement and indicating CodeSystem/ValueSet authoritativeSource extensions should use it.
Published FHIR Extension Pack decision deprecating valueset-authoritativeSource and updating the codesystem-authoritativeSource deprecation message to point to artifact-authoritativeSource.
